subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Regularity’ from the given sentence.**

The doctor's examination revealed a significant abnormality in the patient's cardiovascular system.
solution: The correct answer is **"Abnormality."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Regularity"** means conformity to a rule or principle. (नियमितता) • **Example**: *Aircraft passed overhead with monotonous **regularity**__.* • **"Abnormality"** means deviation from the norm. (सामान्‍य से भिन्‍न वस्‍तु, अवस्‍था आदि; असामान्‍यता) __ • **Example**: *He was born with an **abnormality**__ of the heart.* • The sentence talks about a significant deviation from the norm in the patient's cardiovascular system. • **Regularity**'s antonym is **Abnormality**. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Examination** refers to the act of inspecting or assessing something. (सावधानीपूर्वक जाँच, बारीक छानबीन, तहक़ीक़ात) • **Significant **means notable or important. (महत्वपूर्ण, काफ़ी बड़ा (इतना कि दीख जाए)) • **Revealed** means to make something known or visible. ((गुप्‍त या पूर्वतः अज्ञात वस्‍तु को) प्रकट करना, रहस्‍य खोल लेना) 3e:T9bc, The correct answer is **"Ambience."**
